scope: Inert package-owned production boot identity and empty vendor-root mountpoint; no automatic activation

root_mount_contract.owner: SquashFS early root-init, outside this package
root_mount_contract.flags: MS_RELATIME, default read-write; neither MS_NOSUID nor MS_NODEV on the Ubuntu root
root_mount_contract.identity: Exact block device, major/minor, GPT start, size, UUID and generation verified by the separately built root-init policy

transient_mount_contract./run: root-init creates or adopts tmpfs and moves it across pivot; native systemd owns its lifecycle, directory0755
transient_mount_contract./tmp: Existing Ubuntu systemd tmp.mount, mode1777, enabled by vendor local-fs.target.wants; not replaced here
transient_mount_contract./proc,/sys,/dev: Existing root-init API mount validation and move, then native systemd/udev; not owned by this package

external_storage_units.policy: Keep separately verified exact UUID units and ownership proofs; do not duplicate them in fstab or this package
